printables.title: Morning & Evening Adhkaar for Kids
printables.description: Help your child build a daily habit of remembering Allah, at the start of the day and before sleep. This printable gathers the morning and evening adhkaar into a simple resource your family can keep close and use every day.
includes: Printable PDF to use at home

printables.title: Little Muslim Word Search
printables.description: Twenty colourful word searches, each introducing an Islamic theme such as the names of the prophets, the pillars of faith and words from the Qur'an. Easy-to-read grids make them ideal for family weekends, homeschooling, Islamic studies classes, travel and quiet time.

printables.title: Du'a for Parents
printables.description: A free printable to help children learn and memorise a Qur'anic du'a for their parents, nurturing gratitude and kindness at home. Pay what you wish, or download it free.
